claim_boundary.allowed: Confidence-valid finite-sample propagation from registered iid query-channel estimates to finite-horizon adaptive upper-risk-polytope deficiency on the frozen v0.41 population fixture.

confidence.channel_event: Bonferroni-simultaneous shared-binary Hoeffding event over three query parameters
confidence.numerics: 80-digit Decimal log and square root, converted outward to binary float

gates.A0: Classification adaptive passes and open-loop fails with strict 1/1000 margins.
gates.C0: Every exact population deficiency lies inside its sampled confidence interval.
gates.D0: Both root-group modes pass with strict 1/1000 margins.
gates.H0: The registered simultaneous query-channel TV event holds on the visible synthetic population.
gates.P0: The exact preregistration test count passes.
gates.R0: Exactly two decision problems by two policy modes are emitted.
gates.RESOURCE: The single-process wall-time and memory ceilings hold.
gates.S0: Every registered source and environment hash matches.
gates.U0: The exact query, target, sample, seed-derivation, and pooling universe is preserved.
